content:
Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

When a Government servant is transferred without any break in service to a new post under State Government or in another Department under Central Government covered by GPF Rules, his subscription together with interest thereon will, and in the case of those governed by CPF Rules, the Government contribution as well, be transferred to his account under  
the Central / State Government, as the case may be.
